code:
kubectl apply -f checkout-deployment.yaml
  -> kube-apiserver    validates YAML, writes to etcd
  -> controller-manager  creates 3 Pod objects
  -> kube-scheduler    assigns each Pod to a node
  -> kubelet (on node)  starts the containers
caption: No component skips a layer — that's what keeps a 100+ node cluster predictable.
